# Crosshair – Custom Aim Overlay

> Crosshair is an Android application that enables mobile gamers to place and customize an on-screen crosshair overlay on top of supported mobile games.

## Overview
Crosshair runs independently via Android's native `SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW` permission to render a hardware-accelerated, high-contrast reticle on mobile screens. It never modifies game binaries, memory (RAM), or network packets, making it 100% compliant and ban-safe.

## Core Features
- **Esports Presets Library**: Built-in Dot, Classic Cross (+), Circle, Sniper T-Cross, Box, and Diamond reticle geometries.
- **Custom PNG Import**: Import any transparent PNG crosshair image directly from the Android gallery.
- **Pixel-Perfect Editor**: Millimeter controls for length, thickness, center gap, opacity, outer stroke outline, and center dot.
- **Dynamic Color Spectrum**: High-contrast shades (Neon Green `#69F0AE`, Cyber Cyan `#00E5FF`, Electric Violet `#8B5CF6`, Valor Red `#FF4655`, Sun Orange `#FF9100`, Pure White).
- **Floating Quick Toggle**: In-game HUD bubble to enable, disable, or adjust reticle positions without minimizing the active game.
- **Lightweight Engine**: Hardware-accelerated vector drawing with <0.5% CPU load and negligible battery consumption.

## Platform & Availability
- **Operating System**: Android (Android 7.0 Nougat to Android 15+)
- **Store**: Official download exclusively via Google Play Store
- **Note**: iOS (iPhone) and PC (Windows) are not supported.
